name: Pnpm
help: pnpm is a fast, disk space efficient package manager for the Node JavaScript platform.<para/>Files inside <c>node_modules</c> are hard linked or cloned from a single content-addressable storage on disk, saving disk space and speeding up installations.

tasks.help: Runs <c>pnpm clean</c> followed by <c>pnpm install --frozen-lockfile</c>. Designed for CI/CD environments.

properties.name: Dir
properties.help: Change to directory <c><dir></c>.

properties.name: Reporter
properties.help: Controls how output is reported.

properties.name: LogLevel
properties.help: What level of logs to report.

properties.name: Silent
properties.help: No output is logged to the console, not even fatal errors.

tasks.help: Installs all dependencies of the project in the current working directory. When executed inside a workspace, installs all dependencies of all projects.

properties.name: Packages
properties.help: List of packages to be installed.

properties.name: Production
properties.help: Packages in <c>devDependencies</c> will not be installed.

properties.name: Dev
properties.help: Only <c>devDependencies</c> will be installed.

properties.name: NoOptional
properties.help: Prevents <c>optionalDependencies</c> from being installed.

properties.name: FrozenLockfile
properties.help: Don't generate a lockfile and fail if an update is needed. This setting is on by default in CI environments.

properties.name: NoFrozenLockfile
properties.help: Forces generating or updating a lockfile even in CI environments.

properties.name: PreferFrozenLockfile
properties.help: If the available <c>pnpm-lock.yaml</c> satisfies the <c>package.json</c> then perform a headless installation.

properties.name: LockfileOnly
properties.help: Dependencies are not downloaded. Only <c>pnpm-lock.yaml</c> is updated.

properties.name: NoLockfile
properties.help: Don't read or generate a <c>pnpm-lock.yaml</c> file.

properties.name: FixLockfile
properties.help: Fix broken lockfile entries automatically.

properties.name: Force
properties.help: Forces reinstalling dependencies: refetch packages modified in store, recreate a lockfile and/or modules directory created by a non-compatible version of pnpm.

properties.name: Global
properties.help: Install package globally.

properties.name: IgnoreScripts
properties.help: Causes pnpm to not execute any scripts defined in the <c>package.json</c>.

properties.name: Offline
properties.help: Trigger an error if any required dependencies are not available in local store.

properties.name: PreferOffline
properties.help: Skip staleness checks for cached data, but request missing data from the server.

properties.name: StoreDir
properties.help: The directory in which all the packages are saved on disk.

properties.name: VirtualStoreDir
properties.help: The directory with links to the store (default is <c>node_modules/.pnpm</c>).

properties.name: ModulesDir
properties.help: The directory in which dependencies will be installed (instead of <c>node_modules</c>).

properties.name: LockfileDir
properties.help: The directory in which the <c>pnpm-lock.yaml</c> will be created.

properties.name: Dir
properties.help: Change to directory <c><dir></c>.

properties.name: Recursive
properties.help: Run installation recursively in every package found in subdirectories.

properties.name: Filters
properties.help: Restricts the scope to package names matching the given pattern.

properties.name: WorkspaceRoot
properties.help: Run the command on the root workspace project.

properties.name: ShamefullyHoist
properties.help: All the subdeps will be hoisted into the root <c>node_modules</c>.

properties.name: ChildConcurrency
properties.help: Controls the number of child processes run parallelly to build node modules.

properties.name: NetworkConcurrency
properties.help: Maximum number of concurrent network requests.

properties.name: StrictPeerDependencies
properties.help: Fail on missing or invalid peer dependencies.

properties.name: PackageImportMethod
properties.help: Method used to clone, hardlink, or copy packages from the store.

properties.name: Reporter
properties.help: Controls how output is reported.

properties.name: LogLevel
properties.help: What level of logs to report.

properties.name: Silent
properties.help: No output is logged to the console, not even fatal errors.

properties.name: AggregateOutput
properties.help: Aggregate output from child processes that are run in parallel.

tasks.help: Runs an arbitrary command from a package's <c>"scripts"</c> object.

properties.name: Command
properties.help: The command to be executed.

properties.name: Arguments
properties.help: Arguments passed to the script.

properties.name: Recursive
properties.help: Run the defined package script in every package found in subdirectories or workspace.

properties.name: Filters
properties.help: Restricts the scope to package names matching the given pattern.

properties.name: Parallel
properties.help: Completely disregard concurrency and topological sorting, running a given script immediately in all matching packages.

properties.name: Sequential
properties.help: Run the specified scripts one by one.

properties.name: IfPresent
properties.help: Avoid exiting with a non-zero exit code when the script is undefined.

properties.name: NoBail
properties.help: The command will exit with a 0 exit code even if the script fails.

properties.name: Stream
properties.help: Stream output from child processes immediately, prefixed with the originating package directory.

properties.name: Arguments

properties.name: Recursive

properties.name: Filters

properties.name: Parallel
properties.help: Completely disregard concurrency and topological sorting, running a given command immediately in all matching packages.

properties.name: ShellMode
properties.help: Runs command inside of a shell (/bin/sh on UNIX and cmd.exe on Windows).

properties.name: Stream

tasks.help: Fetches a package from the registry without installing it as a dependency, hot loads it, and runs whatever default command binary it exposes.

properties.help: The package binary to execute.

properties.name: Arguments
properties.help: Arguments passed to the package binary.

tasks.help: Publishes a package to the npm registry.

properties.name: Target
properties.help: A tarball or directory to publish.

properties.name: Tag
properties.help: Registers the published package with the given tag.

properties.name: Access
properties.help: Tells the registry whether this package should be published as public or restricted.

properties.name: Force
properties.help: Packages are proceeded to be published even if their current version is already in the registry.

properties.name: DryRun
properties.help: Does everything a publish would do except actually publishing to the registry.

properties.name: Json
properties.help: Show information in JSON format.

properties.name: NoGitChecks
properties.help: Don't check if current branch is your publish branch, clean, and up to date.

properties.name: Otp
properties.help: When publishing packages that require two-factor authentication, this option can specify a one-time password.

properties.name: PublishBranch
properties.help: Sets branch name to publish.

properties.name: Recursive
properties.help: Publish all packages from the workspace.

properties.name: ReportSummary
properties.help: Save the list of the newly published packages to <c>pnpm-publish-summary.json</c>.

properties.name: IgnoreScripts
properties.help: Ignores any publish related lifecycle scripts.

properties.name: Dir
properties.help: Change to directory <c><dir></c>.

tasks.help: Creates a tarball from a package.

properties.name: Out
properties.help: Customizes the output path for the tarball.

properties.name: PackDestination
properties.help: Directory in which <c>pnpm pack</c> will save tarballs.

properties.name: DryRun
properties.help: Does everything <c>pnpm pack</c> would do except actually writing the tarball to disk.

properties.name: Json
properties.help: Prints the packed tarball and contents in JSON format.

properties.name: Recursive
properties.help: Pack all packages from the workspace.

properties.name: Filters
properties.help: Restricts the scope to package names matching the given pattern.

properties.name: Dir
properties.help: Change to directory <c><dir></c>.

tasks.help: Checks for known security issues with the installed packages.

properties.name: AuditLevel
properties.help: Only print advisories with severity greater than or equal to the given level.

properties.name: Dev
properties.help: Only audit <c>devDependencies</c>.

properties.name: Prod
properties.help: Only audit <c>dependencies</c> and <c>optionalDependencies</c>.

properties.name: NoOptional
properties.help: Don't audit <c>optionalDependencies</c>.

properties.name: Fix
properties.help: Fix the audited vulnerabilities using the specified method: <c>override</c> or <c>update</c>.

properties.name: IgnoreRegistryErrors
properties.help: Use exit code 0 if the registry responds with an error. Useful in CI.

properties.name: IgnoreUnfixable
properties.help: Ignore all vulnerabilities for which no fix exists.

properties.name: Json
properties.help: Output audit report in JSON format.
